name: AirportLoungeAccessManager
tagline: Entry desk eligibility, capacity and partner billing for airport lounges – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete lounge operations app for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages: an occupancy dashboard with an hour-by-hour forecast, an entry desk that gives an eligibility verdict for cabin, frequent flyer, lounge membership, premium card, voucher, day pass and staff access, a waitlist with a day-pass cut-off, a live in-lounge board with boarding calls and overstays, partner billing by airline, network and card issuer, and a visits list with bulk actions.
features: Eligibility verdict with reasons (cabin, tier, membership, card, voucher, entry window, duplicates)
Capacity in persons with waitlist and day-pass cut-off
Occupancy forecast by hour against capacity
Guest allowance and extra guest fees
Boarding calls, overstay and departed-flight alerts
Partner billing: unbilled, invoiced, paid, disputed; statement CSV
Refusal reasons, undo on every change, bulk actions
Demo mode with fictional data; low-code column mapping
Power Fx outputs and events; optional Dataverse save; Power Pages Web API
controlType: standard (2 controls: AirportLoungeAccessManager data-set + AirportLoungeAccessManagerPortal field)
